allOf.description: Buyer minimums for structured product frequency-cap support. An empty object requests any positive support. Otherwise each array must be a subset of the product's resolved support, where a product field omitted from frequency_cap_support inherits the seller-wide media_buy.frequency_capping declaration (an omitted seller-wide list means every value). Duration units resolve the same way: a requested window or suppression unit matches when the product lists it in window_constraints or suppression_constraints, or, when the product omits that list, when the seller-wide supported_window_units includes it or is omitted. A legacy package declaration of frequency_cap: true satisfies every requirement because its broad meaning is unchanged. Exact count and interval values belong in a concrete cap supplied during discovery.

mutable_fields.description: Require each listed logical field to be mutable after creation. Matches a product whose mutable_fields contains every listed value, or a product that omits mutable_fields, or legacy frequency_cap: true. A product declaring mutable_fields: [] is create-only and never matches a non-empty list.
